functions.name: hausdorff_dimension
functions.signature: float hausdorff_dimension( float *ar, int n,int minl,int maxl,int dl)
functions.purpose: Estimates an array's fractal dimension using the divider method and a linear fit.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Accumulates float distances in double, applies log, stores results as float, and fits a line; preserve loop bounds and accumulation order.
functions.license_note: Code by Balazs Nemeth, Potash Corporation of Saskatoon Saskatchewan, donated to CWP circa 2008.

functions.name: distance
functions.signature: float distance(float x0, float y0, float x1, float y1)
functions.purpose: Computes the Euclidean distance between two points.
functions.float_sensitive_notes: Float arithmetic is passed to sqrt and the double result is converted to float.
functions.license_note: Code by Balazs Nemeth, Potash Corporation of Saskatoon Saskatchewan, donated to CWP circa 2008.
